title: Ancient World Textures
description: Return to the forgotten ages in Minecraft
body:
![ANCIENT WORLD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f35b749c6b17c959575fe7ef9f04fac6fdd1fbb1.png)

Transform your Minecraft world with an ancient and mysterious atmosphere.

Ancient World is a texture pack inspired by ancient civilizations, forgotten kingdoms, and old-world aesthetics. It changes textures for mobs, items, and blocks to give Minecraft a darker and more historical style while keeping the vanilla feeling.

I will do sometimes big updates and old!

Its my Second resource pack so expect bugs!

Compatible with Fresh Animations!
Need ETF and EMF!
Is good!
